name: Sonderbichlhof
beschreibung: The Sonderbichlhof is located on the outskirts of Fügenberg in the Zillertal at about 900 meters above sea level. The house is run as an inn and offers simple, traditional Tiroler Küche. The rooms are functionally furnished. Guests find a quiet, rural atmosphere here with a view of the surrounding mountains. The inn is suitable for hikers and guests looking for casual accommodation in the Zillertal.
